description_ru: Брат и сестра упаковывают вещи, находят старую игрушку и прощаются с квартирой, где выросли.
text:
Dan: Eva, where is the big box? I cannot find the tape.
Eva: It is on the kitchen table. Dan, we have only two days to pack, and the flat is still full of things.
Dan: I know, I know. Mum and Dad's new house is lovely, but moving is hard work.
Eva: Let's start with your room. You have too many books and toys. What do we do with them?
Dan: I keep the books. Perhaps I give some old toys to the little cousins.
Eva: Good idea. I get some boxes from the garage.

Eva: Dan, come here! Look what I find under your bed.
Dan: What is it? Oh no, it is my old red train! I think it is lost for ten years.
Eva: It still has a little key. Do you remember? We play with it every Sunday.
Dan: Of course I remember. You always want to be the driver, and I am the passenger.
Eva: That is because I am older. And I am better at driving trains.
Dan: Ha ha, no, it is because you shout very loudly. Here, put it in the box for the cousins.

Dan: Wait, wait. I don't want to give away the train. It is special.
Eva: Then we keep it. Put it in the box with the books. You can take it to the new house.
Dan: Thank you, Eva. Do you feel sad about the move? This flat is our home for fifteen years.
Eva: A little. Look at the wall in the hall. It still has all our marks. Every year Dad measures us there.
Dan: You are taller than me on every line. It is not fair.
Eva: I am four years older, silly. Don't worry, you grow up one day.

Eva: Mum says the van arrives at nine tomorrow. Is your room ready?
Dan: Almost ready. I only have my clothes and my desk left. What about your room?
Eva: I have eight boxes, and my room is still a mess. I need your help with the heavy things.
Dan: Okay, I help you now. Which one do we take first?
Eva: The big mirror. Be careful! It is glass.
Dan: I hold this side, you hold that side. One, two, three, up! Oh, it is very heavy.

Dan: Eva, I find some old photos in the drawer. Look at this one. We are at the sea.
Eva: I remember! You are five years old, and you cry because a crab is on your foot.
Dan: It is not funny. It is a very big crab.
Eva: It is a very small crab, Dan. Give me the photo. I want to put it in my bag.
Dan: Okay, but I keep the one with the ice cream. That is my favourite day ever.

Dan: Mum, where do I put these boxes?
Mum: Put them in the hall, near the door. And please, nobody is lazy today. We have a lot to do before dinner.
Eva: Mum, what about the kitchen? We still have plates, cups and a lot of pots.
Mum: I wrap them in newspaper. Dad comes home early to help with the big table.
Dan: Can we have pizza for dinner? Nobody wants to cook tonight.
Mum: A pizza is perfect. Eva, please call the pizza place and order two big ones.

Dan: Look at the empty room, Eva. It looks so big without our things.
Eva: Yes. Our voices are loud here. Listen. Hello! Hello!
Dan: Hello! Hello! Ha ha. Let's say goodbye to the flat.
Eva: Goodbye, kitchen. Goodbye, balcony. Goodbye, old window with the broken handle.
Dan: Goodbye, wall with our marks. Wait, Eva, can we take the wall with us?
Eva: No, but Dad takes a photo. Then we have it forever. Come on, the van is here.

Dad: How is the packing going, my children? Wow, the hall is full of boxes.
Eva: We are doing fine, Dad. Dan is very slow, but he works hard.
Dan: I am not slow. I am careful. There is a difference.
Dad: Both of you are great. After the move, we go to the park and have an ice cream together.
Dan: Yes! Chocolate for me.

Eva: Welcome to the new house, little brother. Which room do you want?
Dan: The one with the big window at the front. I can see the tree and the garden from here!
Eva: Then it is yours. I take the small room next to it. We are neighbours now.
Dan: Look, I put the red train on the shelf. It is the first thing in my new room.
Eva: That is perfect. Maybe we play with it on Sunday, like old times.
Dan: Yes, but this time I am the driver!

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Рот открыт широко, звук между «а» и «э»; не заменяйте на «э».
Кончик языка поднят, но не касается нёба и не вибрирует; губы слегка округлены.
Короткий звук, похожий на «а», рот открыт не широко; не заменяйте на «о».
Двигайте язык от «э» к «и»; не произносите как чистое «э» или «эй» с резким «й».

questions.question: What does Eva find under Dan's bed?
What do Eva and Dan see on the wall in the hall?
questions.answer: Marks that show how tall they are.

questions.question: What do they eat for dinner on moving day?
What does Dan put on the shelf in the new room?
